_comment: Starting values. Tighten each one to just above what the first full green run measures, so the budget guards the number the site actually achieves rather than a round figure.
_lighthouse_comment: Production measured 99/100/100/100 on 2026-08-14. Performance is enforced only against a deployed origin: the local development server scores 56 for the same build, because it sends no compression and speaks HTTP/1.1.
